supplier.not_a_successor: The old per-MRC ArcGIS REST URL form is not restored by the WordPress homepage; the currently observed replacement form is the stateful GOnet6 viewer.

sample_of_10.limits: The 8 are unknown, not dead: six official sites plus one relevant page did not expose a current SIG in captured HTML; Bromont and Saint-Prosper ended in TypeError: fetch failed even with the browser UA, without an ENOTFOUND observation.

recommended_relaunch.form: re-acquisition, never a URL substitution or re-stamp
recommended_relaunch.first: For the two verified current GOnet6 viewers, open a stateful browser session and capture the authenticated/proxied MapServer feature response; the captured viewer HTML is only a portal shell, not geometry.
recommended_relaunch.then: For the remaining eight sampled municipalities, rediscover at the municipality/MRC level. If no live vector source is found, re-acquire from a current published zoning PDF.
recommended_relaunch.cost: 2 stateful GOnet6 acquisitions plus 8 municipality/MRC discovery passes, each with durable raw capture and geometry validation. No 186-URL HTTP sweep, no served write, and no restamp is justified by this report.
recommended_relaunch.wayback: Wayback is not proposed as a current-source solution: it would be proof of what was served at an archive date, a change in the nature of the proof.
